scope: Linux AWS image capture SSM resume guards; mocked AWS unit execution only
behavior: Observation timeout retains and resumes the original SSM command
Successful verification survives a host interruption before stopping the builder
Failed verification and inconsistent success/nonzero exit cannot create an image
Unknown submission outcome is not replayed
Builder and command hashes must match; unbound legacy commands require reconciliation
Replacement image requires a new verification; previous receipt is retained
Unavailable builder replacement archives stale command bindings
Linux promotion preserves authorized Windows image permissions
limitations: No EC2 instances created or modified for these tests
No native SSM capture run or fresh CAPI worker bootstrap performed for this change
Selected Python line coverage only; not integration or repository-wide coverage
Lost CreateImage response still requires AMI reconciliation; concurrent inventory writers are unsupported
